Name: Log Bridges Plus
Author: igoutta
Description:
[font=Courier New][center][size=4][u]DESCRIPTION[/u][/size]﻿[/center]
﻿I liked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/622]Monteso idea[/url] to make those little bridges appear to be more safer and natural.
That's why I edited those images and thick' em up, the reason behind was to make them [color=#00ffff]full compatible[/color] with any World Recolor.
Also, I took the old idea of [color=#00ffff]connect[/color] the Lake Islands with the Guild, [color=#e06666](not avaliable)[/color] and show it more natural after the acceptation into the Guild. 
Now, I looked loving idea of [color=#e69138]megmom84[/color][color=#616161] [/color]and make a vibrant Canyon running the area next to Quarry. You can choose between the Canyon, just the Full Lake Connection or None. Choose carefully.

[center][size=4][u]COMPATIBILITY[/u][/size][/center]
If you choose the option of connect the Lake Islands any file that modify the Mountain Area will create a conflict, take notice. This option is available [color=#ffff00]after[/color] the first run in the config file.
﻿Switching options would make you lose any inventory/chest, decos, crops, trees or crafts set on Mountain Area. BEWARE!

[size=4][center][u]REQUERIMENTS[/u]﻿[/center][/size]
Needs SMAPI[color=#ffff00]*[/color] and Content Patcher[color=#ffff00]*[/color] to work. Thanks to the mind and work of Pathos for the base mods.

[center][size=4]﻿﻿[u]ACKNOWLEDGMENT[/u][/size][/center]
To Montesso for the Original idea. This mod is open source.

[u]                                                                                         [/u]
*The mininum version required are SMAPI 2.6 and Content Patcher 1.4.[/font]

Downloads.Description:
Fixed non-blinking window in raining days on summer.

Now you can optionally have a pretty canyon next to your quarry,

PD: Beware when changing option, this would make lost any inventory/chest or decos/trees in the Mountain map.

Manifest.Name: Log Bridges Plus
Manifest.Description: Thicken any basic bridges around the map. Optionally, connect Lake Islands and Guild. Now with a pretty Canyon.
